requests.create.guard: That address has already asked, or it is not an email address.
requests.create.statement: INSERT INTO requests(email, building, lang, created_at) SELECT lower(trim(?1)), ?2, ?3, ?4 WHERE ?1 LIKE '%_@_%._%' ON CONFLICT(email) DO NOTHING

notify.subject: Invitation request from {input.email}
notify.body:
{input.email} asked for an invitation code.
They want to build: {input.building}
